backgroundScene: Gabriel stands at the Herald's Stair of the Radiant Hierarchies — a colossal staircase of light and opal-glass that descends from the Choir-Vault to the gate-threshold. Enormous trumpet-herald monuments line the stair, each one carved with non-readable divine announcement. The Choir-Vault stretches above him, its architecture of white-gold and seraph-gold filling the sky. Bell-metal resonance structures ring from the walls, their tones creating visible vibration patterns in the air. Scroll-seal barriers mark the thresholds between hierarchies. The stair itself seems to continue infinitely downward. The scene communicates: he IS the messenger — the stair exists because the word must be carried.
